extraction.Name: Louis Deon
extraction.Recorded patent: Pat. recorded Aug. 9, 1919, by Home Abstract Co, Martin, So. Dak.
extraction.Buyer: Deeded to C. C. Gates of Nelson, Nebr. by Louis Deon and Julis Deon, his wife, for $5000.00, on July 3, 1919. Recorded July 11, 1919.
extraction.NOTES: Receipt dated Jul. 1, 1918. Taken from the records at the County Seat. Land described as All of Section 16, T. 39-36. Wife's name: Julis Deon.
